dress_and_conduct: Dress modestly in villages: women cover knees and shoulders; swimwear only when swimming or sunbathing, two-piece bikinis only at resorts.
Remove shoes before entering a fale; sit if elders are seated; avoid pointing your toes at others.
Sunday is a day of rest: behave quietly and travel slowly through villages; most activities, sites, fuel stations and businesses are generally closed.
Evening prayer curfew (Sa), usually between 6 and 7 pm for 10 to 20 minutes, announced by a bell or conch and ending with the third signal: avoid walking or driving through villages during it.
sacred_or_restricted_places: Lagoons, bays and beaches are usually village property: ask permission before entering, wait for a local and expect to pay a small cash entry fee.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Village communities (fa'a Samoa); ask your host or a local if unsure.
culture-and-protocol.note: National guidance from the Samoa Tourism Authority applied to this district; no district-specific page found.
